card.problem: A broad business task is slow and users want a shorter summary.
card.user: Any employee who occasionally reads a long document.
card.workflow: A chat box accepts text and returns a generic answer without structured state or follow-through.
card.snowflake_role: A warehouse stores messages, but the named platform is not essential to the experience.
card.execution_proof: A static mockup and claimed prompt result are shown without an authenticated run.
card.product_proof: One screen communicates the concept but has no complete workflow, failure state, deployment proof or submission package.
card.business_case: Reading time may fall, while the buyer, adoption path and measurable value remain unclear.

card.problem: An operations team manually applies repeatable rules to structured and unstructured records.
card.user: A named operational manager responsible for reviewing exceptions.
card.workflow: The prototype ingests fixtures, computes an exception, shows a recommendation and saves one result for review.
card.snowflake_role: Snowflake stores the records and runs a policy near the data, but agent execution and durable multi-step provenance are limited.
card.execution_proof: Source, setup SQL and tests exist. A local end-to-end demo works, while authenticated query evidence and public deployment are absent.
card.product_proof: The main path and one failure state are usable, but review, ownership and a judge-ready package remain partial.
card.business_case: The first buyer and avoided manual effort are credible, though customer proof and expansion economics are untested.

card.problem: A costly operational workflow requires governed data, agent reasoning, explicit policy boundaries and accountable action.
card.user: A narrow professional team with a recurring high-value decision and clear ownership.
card.workflow: One public product shows trusted intake, policy decision, multiple agent capabilities, human review, owned action, replay and failure recovery.
card.snowflake_role: Snowflake is indispensable shared memory and execution infrastructure across source records, Snowpark policy, Cortex Code artifacts, least-privilege reads and query provenance.
card.execution_proof: A fresh authenticated run, exact lifecycle and cardinality audit, reproducible tests, cost controls and query identifiers are independently reloadable.
card.product_proof: A responsive public deployment, English 3-to-5-minute demo, complete PDF deck and signed-out access proof make the entry judge-ready.
card.business_case: The product saves measurable cost or revenue, has a specific buyer and a plausible repeatable commercial model.
